quote: Ring out the old, ring in the new, ring, happy bells, across the snow: the year is going, let him go; ring out the false, ring in the true.
source: Alfred Tennyson, In Memoriam A.H.H., section CVI, lines 5 to 8 (Edward Moxon, 1850)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg 70950, a transcription of the 1850 Edward Moxon first edition of In Memoriam, cross-checked with the Victorian Web text of section CVI.

reason: The 1850 first edition prints the stanza word for word and point for point as proposed. Not shipped, not banned, not at cap.
